requestedDirection: 保持白色黑白与彩色图标/标识；接近HeroUI Pro原生的表面质感，减少装饰线，增加圆润程度。

appliedRecipe.primaryFields: Light mode surface fill plus native field shadow; no default stroke.
appliedRecipe.nestedFields: Secondary neutral fill without a second shadow.
appliedRecipe.darkFieldsAndComposer: Secondary neutral fill without light-mode drop shadows.
appliedRecipe.hover: N02 and I03 use subtle fill; default remains white surface plus field shadow.
appliedRecipe.tabs: 20 rounded segmented tracks wrap existing tab nodes; original tab IDs and prototype targets retained.
appliedRecipe.dividers: Sidebar and inspector group decorative rules removed; meaningful data, focus and error boundaries retained.

nativeAligned: Card radius24 with native light surface shadow
ChatTool radius12, thin border and no default elevation
athenaCustom: Composer radius24 plus surface shadow; native stacked PromptInput is radius16 with no default elevation
Overlay22 applied to scoped notification/player surfaces
Dark overlay inner highlight alpha0.22 versus native0.30

resolvedFindings.issue: New bound paints retained a white fallback in the dark rendering
resolvedFindings.fix: Resolved each bound paint for its consumer and materialized actual RGB; dark fields/composer use the secondary neutral surface

resolvedFindings.issue: Color plane and inner fields inherited an unnecessary second shadow
resolvedFindings.fix: The functional color plane is unraised; inner fields use secondary fill without shadow; outer popup alone uses overlay elevation

resolvedFindings.issue: Filled default controls risked losing the previous hover distinction
resolvedFindings.fix: Radius-hover and CSS-hover explicitly use subtle fill while default is surface + field shadow; actual default/hover/focus sheets visually checked

resolvedFindings.issue: White color swatches became hard to distinguish on white fields
resolvedFindings.fix: Added an inner neutral edge to white swatches without altering their sampled values

resolvedFindings.issue: Initial player center-control styling put shadow on an inner row inside an existing player overlay.
resolvedFindings.fix: Moved 22px radius and native overlay style to the outer ready/buffering overlay. Inner center row uses transparent fill, radius 0 and no effects.
resolvedFindings.verifiedBy: Fresh screenshot of 17:10970 and final property readback for both ready and buffering containers.
